This analysis will look at which genes are elevated in the forebrain using information form the Human Protein Atlas.
```{r}
sum(180,57,83,110)
```
 430 genes are elevated in the human forebrain. 
```{r}
sum(109,157,31,45)
```
 
342 genes are elvated in the pig forebrain. 
```{r}
sum(55,185,60,98)
```
398 genes are elevated in the mouse forebrain. 
Humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
